  -- Result: Reported conflicting data and the need to check IMDb directly.
- Agent: Planner

  -- Observation: Noted the discrepancy between Fred O'Bannion and Benny O'Donnell.
  -- Thought: Decided to have WebSurfer open the specific IMDb full credits page to get the canonical character name.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to open https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0106677/fullcredits.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Navigated to the IMDb full credits page for Dazed and Confused.
  -- Observation: The page loaded, showing the cast list. Snippets in search results indicated "Ben Affleck as Fred O'Bannion".
  -- Thought: Confirmed that IMDb lists Ben Affleck as Fred O'Bannion, resolving the previous conflict.
  -- Result: Confirmed the character name is Fred O'Bannion.
